notes: Pages use Parcoursup for French/European Bac holders. For a Moroccan Bac holder, the application must go through Études en France / Campus France (page: candidature-en-1ere-annee-but-a-l-universite-iut). applicationChannel therefore omitted per instructions and stakeholder review. Tuition: the page displays 178 EUR/year (exoneration rate) but does not explicitly state it applies to the non-EU student; a Campus France page lists differentiating fees of 2 902 EUR/year for Licence for non-EU students, but does not cover this specific programme, so the programme-level amount kept is 178 EUR with a caveat. The non-EU fee may be higher. The requirement for French (B2) is stated at programme level by the Parcoursup page and confirmed as compulsory for Campus France applications on the Campus France page. The English competence criterion is quoted from the national expected knowledge for BUT RT; not a formal certificate requirement.
